$comment: Size ceilings (bytes) for built Studio bundles, checked by scripts/check-bundle-budget.ts. Studio is a dev tool so end users don't download it, but it is unmonitored otherwise (the codecov bundle path is broken — see codecov-bundle-analysis-diagnosis.md). Raise a ceiling deliberately, with justification, when a real feature grows it.
$which-studio-js: THE UNSPLIT ONE. bundle-analysis.yml runs `bun run build:metafile` and then this check, and that script is a single `bun build` with no `splitting` and no shared contract — so the dist/studio.js it measures inlines Monaco and everything else (~14.5 MB). `bun run build` writes a DIFFERENT dist/studio.js at the same path: ~2.9 MB, with Monaco split out into dist/chunks. Measure the metafile build before touching a ceiling here; the release build's figure is five times smaller and setting a ceiling from it reds the lane.
$ratchet: monaco-editor 0.55.1 -> 0.56.0 moved the metafile build 14202972 -> 14572625 bytes (+369653, +2.6%), and the split release build 13822091 -> 14189667 over the same change. The old 14000000 ceiling was already being met on tolerance rather than under the ceiling (main sat at 101.4%), which is how a real 2.6% growth would have been absorbed silently. Raised deliberately to just above the measured figure so the next regression has to be argued for.
